# Sections: throughput (the protocol of the brief: one tree per process, 7 rounds in alternating order, median of 5 repeats inside a process; before = the head of 1b.7f, 31bc0646, without the reader count; after = the FIRST version of the reader count, one shared count, taken before the count was striped; the guard sections below measure all three versions);

# guard (the in-process instrument of FacadeGuardCostTests: alternating batches of the facade call and the call of the index behind it, medians of 15 batches, 5 processes per version; the guard column is IsEmpty minus the read of the length of the index);
